Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the national armed forces: The garrison of Dédougou begins its preparations with a popular cross-country
Burkina Faso.summary: The National Armed Forces launched, in Dédougou, in the Bankui region, the regional activities commemorating the 66th anniversary of their creation, on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, through a popular cross-country race followed by an aerobics session . As a prelude to the regional celebration of the 66th anniversary of the existence of the Burkinabe National Army on November 1, several preparatory activities are on display in Bankui and Sourou.

Niger.title: Border security and energy interests.. What is behind Algeria's decision to send troops to Niger?
Niger.summary: The Algerian parliament, in its two chambers, the People's National Assembly and the National Assembly, on Sunday, approved the request of President Abdelmadjid Tebboune to send units of the Algerian army to Niger, with the aim of protecting the strategic interests of the country and securing the investment projects of the state company Sonatrach, in response to a request from the Nigerian authorities.

Niger.title: Nigerien, 3 others nabbed over guard’s killing, theft
Niger.summary: Operatives of the Edo State Police Command have arrested a Niger Republic national and three others over the alleged killing of a security guard and theft of goods worth over N400 million in the state. The suspects, identified as Hamisu Nuhu, Suleiman Rabiu, Hussaini Gago, a Nigerien, and Ibrahim Haruna, were arrested in connection with a robbery at Paparazzi Communication Complex in Auchi, Etsako West Local Government Area, on July 12, 2026.
